_rulings._source: Rules owner (the user), 2026-11-16, and the official FAQ where noted.
_rulings.ramp: A ramp can only be jumped forward: entered from the space directly behind it (moving forward). A car entering a ramp from its sides is destroyed.
_rulings.quake: Vehicles pushed off the sides or the back, or onto an impassable space, are eliminated. A vehicle pushed past the front edge reveals the new road tile. The landing spaces reveal their hazards and apply their terrain. Vehicles ending on the same space slam. Official FAQ: resolve the landings as simultaneously as possible, failing that in a random order (here: all move together, then each landing in a random order).
_rulings.revealed_terrain_hazards: A desert glass, ramp or fire hazard affects at once the vehicle that revealed it (it has just entered the new terrain).
_rulings.pit_trap_missed: The vehicle stays on the space (now impassable) and goes on with its remaining moves.
_rulings.sand_worm: Farthest back: odd rows count half a space forward.
_rulings.toxic_goo_and_slam: The car stops first (its moves are lost), then the slam happens.
_rulings.faq_big_rig_quake: Official FAQ, for the Big Rig expansion: Sturdy prevents the Quake from moving the Big Rig; it takes a minor damage on a command of its owner's choice instead; as the Quake is discarded after resolving, no off-road token is placed.

on_fire_tokens._note: 12 in the box (plus extras, p2); unlimited in play (ruling 2026-11-16).

setup: Shuffle the new road tiles in with the standard road tiles before placing the middle and lead road tiles; the game still starts on 1a The Parking Lot or 1b Runway to Ruin.
Mix the new damage tokens into the standard damage token pile.
Mix the new hazard tokens into the standard hazard token pile.
Shuffle the ongoing effect cards and place the deck to the side.
Place the ON FIRE! tokens in a separate pile to the side.

terrain._codes: One character per space in a tile's terrain rows, as in game_base.json (R road, o off-road, M mud, X impassable).

G.name: Toxic Goo
G.rule: When a road vehicle enters a toxic goo space, it stops and loses the rest of its moves.

D.name: Desert Glass
D.rule: When a road vehicle enters a desert glass space, it immediately moves one space in the direction it was already moving without using any moves.

P.name: Ramp
P.rule: A road vehicle can only enter a ramp from the space directly behind the ramp. When it does, roll the stunt die and move that many spaces directly forward, ignoring all spaces in between. After landing, lose all remaining moves. If a road vehicle enters a ramp space from any other space, the road vehicle is eliminated.

F.name: Fire!
F.rule: When a road vehicle enters this space, it catches on fire: place an ON FIRE! token on that vehicle's dashboard.

S.name: Salt Flats
S.rule: When a road vehicle enters a salt flat space, it may use the road die this turn regardless of whether or not it moved on only road spaces.

quake.name: Quake
quake.rule: Roll the direction die. Move all road vehicles one space in that direction, simultaneously.

sand_worm.name: Sand Worm
sand_worm.rule: Eliminate the road vehicle that is the farthest back on the board. If more than one road vehicle is tied for that position, eliminate each of them.

desert_glass.name: Desert Glass
desert_glass.rule: This space becomes a desert glass space.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.rule: This space becomes a ramp space.

fire.name: Fire!
fire.rule: This space becomes a fire! space.

pit_trap.name: Pit Trap
pit_trap.rule: Roll the shooting die against the road vehicle that revealed the trap. If it's a hit, the vehicle is eliminated. Otherwise, it may continue moving if it has moves left. Pit Trap remains on the board and is treated as an impassable space.

damage_tokens._rule: When you get one, resolve its effect. If your car was moving, it loses any remaining moves. A car with two damage is inoperable.

on_fire.name: On Fire
on_fire.rule: Take an ON FIRE! token from the supply and place it on that car's dashboard. Then place the damage token face down.

ongoing_effect.name: Ongoing Effect
ongoing_effect.rule: Draw an ongoing effect card and place it face up in an available damage slot. Place the damage token face down on top of it. The card remains in effect until that damage token is repaired. When that damage is repaired, remove both the damage token and the ongoing effect card and place them in their respective discard piles.

rules: During your Move step, before moving a road vehicle that has an ON FIRE! token, roll the fire die and apply the result.
+1 / +2: increase the vehicle's moves this turn by the indicated amount. This may result in movement higher than 6. You must move the full amount.
Fire goes out: remove the vehicle's ON FIRE! token and move as normal.
ON FIRE! tokens do not count as damage.
If a vehicle that is on fire becomes inoperable, remove the ON FIRE! token.
A vehicle that is already on fire cannot take additional ON FIRE! tokens. If it would, ignore it.

ongoing_effects.name: Transmission Failure
ongoing_effects.text: Before this car moves, set its movement die to 1. It cannot gain additional moves.
